verdict.rationale: TruffleHog's CLI can scan an entire GitHub org (`--org=trufflesecurity`) or multiple heterogeneous sources (git, Jira, Slack, Confluence, Teams, Sharepoint) in a single invocation, and JSON output enables scripted/bulk automation (confirmed by a hands-on probe scan). This demonstrates bulk scanning across many items, but there's no explicit multi-target batch API, queueing, or documented bulk-remediation/bulk-tagging workflow for AI-native orchestration beyond scan-time scope selection. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API or SDK for programmatic multi-target orchestration, evidence of bulk result management (e.g., mass triage/remediation across findings) rather than just bulk scanning input.
